units.source_text: 古昔禁中惯例：正月中第一个子日，内膳司用七种新菜作羹供奉，谓食之可去百病。

en.t: According to an ancient custom in the imperial court: on the first Day of the Rat in the first month, the Office of Palace Cuisine made a soup from seven kinds of fresh greens and offered it to the court; it was said that eating it could ward off all illnesses.
The title of this chapter is based on that custom.
